title: Sr.Quality Assurance Executive
description:
**Company Profile**

A reputed multinational Buying and Sourcing Agency with over 40 years of industry experience, operating through offices in India and overseas. We specialize in the sourcing and supply of a wide range of textile products, delivering comprehensive procurement, quality assurance, and supply chain solutions to customers worldwide.

**Job Description / Responsibilities:**

Responsible for monitoring and maintaining quality standards throughout all stages of garment production, from raw material inspection to final shipment. Ensure that products consistently meet customer quality requirements by implementing effective quality control measures at every stage of the manufacturing process.

Key responsibilities include conducting in-line and final inspections, providing quality approvals, identifying and resolving quality issues, and ensuring compliance with customer specifications and industry standards. Effectively implement and monitor the Quality Assurance Plan through continuous production follow-up to achieve consistent product quality and on-time delivery.

**Desired profile of the candidate**
:

B.Tech in Textile/Apparel Technology, Diploma in Garment Technology (DGT/GMT), Sound knowledge of garment construction, pattern making, pattern checking, grading, fit analysis, measurement standards, fabrics, trims, and garment manufacturing processes. Proficient in conducting pre-production, in-line, final, and shipment inspections with knowledge of AQL standards. Strong decision-making, analytical, and computer skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team, perform under pressure, and consistently achieve business, quality, and shipment targets while ensuring customer satisfaction.

title: GARMENTS QUALITY CONTROLLER
description:
**We are \#hiring Garments Quality Controller at Jay Jay Mills (India) Pvt Ltd!** 




  





 Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 Salary: Best in the Industry
 



 Experience: Freshers / 1–3 Years \-Garments Field
 



 Qualification: Any Degree (Textile background preferred; other majors may also apply)
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 




 · Inspect garments during manufacturing to identify defects and determine causes.
 



 · Coordinate with production and merchandising teams for quality improvements.
 



 · Check stitch count during sewing to maintain consistency.
 



 · Inspect collar attachment and overall garment symmetry.
 



 · Detect and record the garment defects.
 



 · Maintain detailed reports on quality findings and suggest corrective actions.
 



 · Ensure compliance with company quality standards and buyer requirements.
